source.sqlReaderQuery:
select 
a.table_catalog as SRC_CATALOG,
a.table_schema as SRC_SCHEMA,
a.table_name as SRC_TABLE,
'landing' as SINK_CONTAINER,
'/'+a.table_name as SINK_FOLDER,
'select '+STRING_AGG(b.column_name,',')+ ' from '+a.table_schema+'.'+a.table_name as QUERY,
'ModifiedDate' as DELTA_COL,
'1995-01-01 00:00:00.000' as LPV,
'Y' as INCREMENTAL_FLAG ,
1 as IS_ACTIVE,
'' as KeyColumn
from information_schema.tables as a 
join information_schema.columns as b
on a.table_name=b.table_name and a.table_schema=b.table_schema
where a.table_type like ('Base table')
and a.table_schema not in ('dbo')
group by a.table_catalog,
a.table_schema,
a.table_name,
a.table_type
